task_title: speclang start must not claim a dashboard on an occupied port and must report MCP truthfully
task_criteria: With port 3000 occupied, node scripts/speclang.cjs start either exits non-zero naming EADDRINUSE or binds+announces a different free port; the announced /api/status answers 200; mcp status after start reports running (or banner+docs stop claiming MCP is part of start); speclang stop still stops what start launched

items.criterion: With port 3000 occupied, node scripts/speclang.cjs start either exits non-zero naming EADDRINUSE or binds+announces a different free port; the announced /api/status answers 200; mcp status after start reports running (or banner+docs stop claiming MCP is part of start); speclang stop still stops what start launched
items.detail: (The CLI is bin/speclang; no scripts/speclang.cjs exists in the repo root — the criterion's path names the same entrypoint.) Occupied port: bin/speclang:351 prints only 'Dashboard: binding port ...' (no URL); startDaemon (specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/index.ts:170-187, compiled in dist/src/daemon/index.js:175-187) awaits listenDashboard, and on EADDRINUSE calls abortStart (removes .speclang/daemon.pid) and process.exit(1) naming the port and EADDRINUSE; probeDashboard (specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/dashboard.ts:79-139) additionally rejects a 401 stranger or foreign PID before any announcement. Healthy start: URL printed only after bind+probe (index.ts:212) and /api/status answers 200 (index.ts:114-116). MCP truth: banner prints 'MCP: not started — run `speclang mcp start`' (index.ts:219), help text changed to 'file watcher + dashboard' (bin/speclang:335), README.md:121,169,789 and GETTING-STARTED.md:26-27,120-121 no longer claim start runs MCP, and `mcp status` reports 'Status: Not running' (bin/speclang:1613) consistently. Stop: bin/speclang:556-583 SIGTERMs the pid from .speclang/daemon.pid. Test evidence: `TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/daemon-dashboard-bind.test.ts tests/cli/start-bind-truthfulness.test.ts` exit 0, 'Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 11 passed (11)' — covering occupied-port exit/EADDRINUSE/no-banner, 401-stranger non-adoption, announced /api/status 200, MCP truth, and fast stop; full suite `npx vitest run` finished EXIT_CODE=0, 'Test Files 129 passed | 4 skipped (133), Tests 2082 passed | 58 skipped (2140)'.

items.criterion: derived: the dashboard URL is announced only after the bind is verified (no pre-bind URL claim on any start path)
items.detail: bin/speclang:351 prints 'Dashboard: binding port ...' instead of a URL; the URL is printed only in startDaemon after listenDashboard resolved AND probeDashboard confirmed this process's PID (specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/index.ts:170-212; dist/src/daemon/index.js:175-212 matches).

items.criterion: derived: a failed start leaves no stale daemon state (pid file removed, status reports not running)
items.detail: abortStart (specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/index.ts:88-103) stops the daemon if started and unlinks .speclang/daemon.pid on bind failure, probe failure, and daemon.start() failure; tests/cli/start-bind-truthfulness.test.ts:232-235 asserts daemon.pid absent and `status` reports 'Daemon: Not running' after a failed start — passed in the recorded run.

items.criterion: derived: the compiled dist/ artifact that bin/speclang actually loads contains the fix
items.detail: bin/speclang:355 requires ../dist/src/daemon/index.js; grep of dist/src/daemon/index.js shows listenDashboard/probeDashboard/EADDRINUSE handling at lines 175-194 and 'MCP: not started' at line 219; src/daemon/dashboard.ts is a symlink to specs/daemon.spec.dir/src/dashboard.ts.
